scope: Project-bound agent package export; isolated no-real-AI verification, not a release or effectiveness claim.

checks.portableSchema: Official Agent Plugins 1.0 manifest and MCP schemas passed; semantic native checks are separate.
checks.wrappers: PowerShell and Bash forwarding retained spaced arguments with local stubs; no install performed.
checks.independentReview: Bare-command/routing/ownership contract static review passed; OpenCode instructions-only delta reviewed separately.

claudeCode.proved: Final generated plugin validate succeeded with no manifest errors or warnings.
claudeCode.notProved: Model-facing delivery or natural skill selection.

copilotCli.proved: Final generated portable package recognized by --plugin-dir plugin list.
copilotCli.notProved: MCP runtime connection or model-facing delivery from this package.

codex.proved: Real SharpDeps 0.5.0 MCP explore listed and thread runtime connected; original bundle hashes unchanged, zero model turns and no remaining owned processes.
codex.setup: Bare standard verification apphost through isolated PATH; byte-identical package copy with relative local-marketplace source.
codex.notProved: Global-tool shim installation, fixed executable identity through PATH, model-facing guidance, or managed removal/update after relocation.

opencode.proved: Generated MCP and instructions preserved. Both initial and post-explore loopback payloads contain routing once and MCP init instructions once. No sharpdeps-routing skill metadata/body; generated skills key and SKILL.md absent.
opencode.genericSkillTool: May remain available from the fixture; this is not registration of the omitted SharpDeps skill.
opencode.notProved: Natural model adoption, token savings, quality improvement or global-tool installation.

limitations: Host checks prove different layers; they do not establish equivalent model-facing delivery across all four hosts.
UseAppHost=true was a verification-only build override; product project defaults and global-tool installation were unchanged.

Earlier unpublished draft exports, including OpenCode packages containing skills, need not match the final v1 renderer and are outside managed-removal compatibility guarantees. Preserve earlier artifacts; do not delete them automatically. After release, keep versioned guidance/renderers immutable.
OpenCode previously duplicated routing after explicit skill loading; final instructions-only form removes that registration. No real-model comparison quantifies the effect.
No new paid AI runs, sign-in, user profile edits or publication. Existing paid comparison results remain unchanged.
Exact-tree checks are not a cryptographic ownership or adversarial race-free guarantee. Cancellation can retain staging files. Host auto-discovery may observe an explicitly selected output directory.
